blocks.text: Featuring Khalid, Cash Cash, Wolf Alice, DENȲ, Kiana V and SHNTI. PLUS63 Festival is set to return on Saturday, November 28, 2026, bringing fans the whole festival experience at the Aseana City Concert Grounds. Tickets are now on sale at www.PLUS63Festival.com, ranging from Php 3,800 to Php 13,000. Headlining this year’s lineup is Grammy-nominated and multi-platinum singer Khalid, best known for hits like “Young Dumb & Broke”, “Silence”, “Better,” and “Location.” This marks his return to Manila since his American Teen Tour in 2018.
